_doc: The lab's automated flags (analyse.py). Each rule needs its measure past 'over' for 'ticks' ticks in a row on one part after he goes limp, so a one-tick spike at an impact doesn't count (its peak is still reported). Provisional: set 2026-10-11 from the first baseline (README.md, Thresholds); they flag, they don't judge. Move them with a line in 'history'.

sunk_into_world.what: a part more than 3 cm into the ground, a wall or furniture for 4+ ticks

limb_through_body.what: two of his own non-adjacent parts' capsules 5 cm deeper into each other than at the start, for a third of a second (the parts don't collide with each other)

joint_pulled_apart.what: a part 3 cm off its joint's anchor for 4+ ticks

swing_past_limit.what: a cone joint swung 10 deg past its limit for a tenth of a second

twist_past_limit.what: a cone joint twisted 15 deg past its limit for a tenth of a second

limb_inversion.what: a knee or elbow bent 10 deg the wrong way for a tenth of a second

discontinuity.what: a part moved over 0.25 m or turned over 45 deg in one tick

launch.what: a part 8 m/s faster than he was going when he went down (a fall from standing tops out near 5-6)

bounce.what: his centre of mass going up faster than 0.4 m/s after it had come down 0.3 m

lingering_motion.what: a part moving faster than 8 cm/s after he had settled

never_settled.what: not every part under 5 cm/s and 0.3 rad/s for half a second by the end

awake_at_end.what: a part not asleep at the end

history: 2026-10-11: first set, from the first baseline (gameplay session).
